_comment: GOVERNED, NON-LOADED EXAMPLE — engine-runtime/04 (NFR-005, Tier-2). This file is a reference only.
ASP.NET Core auto-loads ONLY appsettings.json + appsettings.{ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT}.json, so this
file is NEVER loaded by the host or CI (the committed default in appsettings.json stays Provider=Fake
— CI has no governed endpoint and never egresses). To activate the live provider in a governed
deployment, the orchestrator supplies these Generation:* values as env vars (Generation__Provider,
Generation__Endpoint, ...) sourced VERBATIM from the infrastructure/modules/ai.bicep outputs — see
the mapping table in docs/features/engine-runtime/PROVIDER-GOVERNANCE.md. ClaudeFoundry is the
quality-preferred alternative (same keys, Provider=ClaudeFoundry, Endpoint=ai.bicep claudeEndpoint).
Auth is keyless (DefaultAzureCredential) — no API key is ever stored here or anywhere.
